evidence: app/src/routes/abilities/[name]/index.tsx — the entire feature is one self-contained route directory
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:270 — the only other abilities links are this one section; delete it plus the loader mapping at :174
app/src/routes/layout.tsx:13-16 — nav has no abilities link, so no nav edit needed
app/src/global.css:449 — .hidden-note is the only feature-specific CSS to sweep
removability.rationale: Routes map one-to-one to features and inbound links are few and grep-able; removing a feature means deleting a directory plus one clearly-delimited section elsewhere.

evidence: app/src/lib/data.ts:104 vs app/src/routes/index.tsx:67 — sprite derivation duplicated (ref's pokemon id vs species id); a card-level fix lands in 2-3 places incl. routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:158
app/src/routes/moves/[name]/index.tsx:22, app/src/routes/types/[name]/index.tsx:20, app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:48 — the same typeEn map is rebuilt in three loaders
app/src/lib/urls.ts:18 — only homeUrl is centralized; /pokemon, /types, /moves links are inlined at components/card-grid.tsx:14, components/moves-table.tsx:98-101, routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:299
app/src/lib/api.ts:6-62 — by contrast, API base URL, cache, and media prefix are one file, which is exactly the seam you want
changeability.rationale: Data-layer fixes usually land in lib/, but Pokémon-card construction, type-name mapping, and URL building are each duplicated across 2-3 files, so a maintainer must find all sites before fixing.

evidence: app/src/routes/* — every loader goes through lib/api.ts + lib/data.ts; no component fetches data
app/src/components/card-grid.tsx:8 — CardGrid takes a plain CardItem[] prop; no reach into route internals
app/src/components/moves-table.tsx:31-40 — sorting state is self-contained in the component via useSignal
app/src/lib/data.ts:66 vs app/src/components/card-grid.tsx:3 — CardData duplicates CardItem instead of importing it
app/src/routes/index.tsx:37-47 — PokeAPI shape knowledge (type records listing pokemon, generation species lists) inlined in the route loader rather than lib/data.ts
coupling.rationale: Layering and server/client separation are genuinely clean; the tangles are small: a duplicated card type and domain-shape logic living in the home route instead of the data layer.

evidence: app/src/components/card-grid.tsx:6-11 — CardItem carries optional types/hidden flags matching the real variation (home shows types, ability shows hidden)
app/src/components/moves-table.tsx:21-23 — showLevel boolean flag rather than a column-descriptor, but only one real variation exists
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:32-170 — species+evolution+version groups+move-table grouping all inline in one 140-line loader; none of it reusable for a similar feature
app/src/routes/{moves,abilities,types}/[name]/index.tsx — page skeleton (loader + h1 + NotFound + head resolveValue) is copy-paste ×4 with no shared resource-page seam
app/src/lib/data.ts:24-38 — getTypes is a clean, short template a sibling getItems() could clone
abstraction_design.rationale: The shared components stretch well and the lib helpers are the right shape, but the Pokemon page loader is monolithic and detail pages are copied rather than derived, so 'similar-but-different' means copy-adapt.

findings.issue: Generated build bundles (entry.node-server.js, q-*.js chunks, assets) sit inside app/ and are not covered by .gitignore (only /data/, /.data-cache/, node_modules/ are), so they will be committed and pollute every diff; npm start also runs the stale server/entry.node-server.js if src changes aren't rebuilt.
findings.suggestion: Add app/dist, app/server and app/tmp to .gitignore and rely on `npm run build`, which the harness already runs.

findings.issue: Pokémon-card construction (id, speciesName, human, sprite) exists twice: cardsForPokemonRefs here and the inline mapping in app/src/routes/index.tsx:63-72, and the two disagree on which ID feeds spriteUrl (ref pokemon id at data.ts:104 vs species id at index.tsx:67), which is exactly the class of bug the sprite scenario describes.
findings.suggestion: Extract a single cardForSpecies()/cardsForSpecies() helper in lib/data.ts (with optional types/hidden) and have the home loader use it.

findings.issue: The route loader monolithically handles species, default variety, evolution tree, version-group resolution, per-method move grouping and move-record fetching; none of it is reusable or independently testable.
findings.suggestion: Move the version-group/moves-table grouping into lib/data.ts (e.g. getMoveTables(pokemon, gameName)) and the evolution mapping alongside it, leaving the loader as thin composition.

findings.issue: The API surface is typed as Promise<any> throughout (apiFetch, TypeInfo.record, CardData fields), so a change to API shapes compiles silently and breaks at runtime instead of at type-check time.
findings.suggestion: Define interfaces for the handful of records actually consumed (NamedAPIResource, Pokemon, Species, Type, Move) and type apiFetch<T>.

findings.issue: The typeEn lookup map is rebuilt in three loaders (also routes/types/[name]/index.tsx:20 and routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:48).
findings.suggestion: Add a typeEnglishName()/getTypeNameMap() helper to lib/data.ts next to getTypes().

findings.issue: URL construction is only half-centralized: homeUrl exists, but /pokemon/<name>, /types/<name> and /moves/<name> are inlined in components/card-grid.tsx:14, components/moves-table.tsx:98-101, routes/types/[name]/index.tsx:75, routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:222,299.
findings.suggestion: Add pokemonUrl/typeUrl/moveUrl to urls.ts so a URL-scheme change is one edit.

findings.issue: CardData duplicates the shape of CardItem (components/card-grid.tsx:3) with a required hidden field instead of importing it; the two can drift.
findings.suggestion: Import CardItem from components/card-grid.tsx (or move the type into lib) and reuse it.

findings.issue: undici is declared a devDependency, but the production server bundle imports it at runtime (app/server/entry.node-server.js:1 does import{...}from"undici"); it currently resolves only transitively via qwik-city's undici "*" dependency.
findings.suggestion: Move undici to dependencies (or remove it and let qwik-city's own dependency provide it explicitly).

findings.issue: No unit tests anywhere in app/ (testLoc 0); pure helpers like cardsForPokemonRefs, humanize/englishName and the move-table grouping are the regression-prone parts and are trivially testable.
findings.suggestion: Add a few vitest cases for lib/format.ts, lib/data.ts filtering/mapping and the moves grouping once it is extracted.

summary: This is a cleanly organized Qwik City app: one data seam (lib/api.ts with base URL, cache and media prefix), shared CardGrid/MovesTable/NotFound components, and routes that map 1:1 to features, so removal and data-source changes are easy. The main drags on editability are duplicated Pokémon-card construction between lib/data.ts and the home loader (which also disagree on which ID feeds the sprite URL), a 140-line monolithic Pokémon route loader, and copy-pasted page scaffolding. I'd approve after adding .gitignore entries for build output and unifying card construction.
